cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Requirements Analyst to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities: The Requirements Analyst will work with product owners and our customers to identify and interpret software requirements and design specifications. You will also review client policies and processes to extract requirements for solution design. You will be expected to translate technical information into clear, readable documents to be used by technical and non-technical personnel. You will work across business and technical teams to help identify, track, and manage business, functional, and technical requirements throughout the full lifecycle of the solution, including creating and maintaining a Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) and providing support for testing against the requirements. As a senior consultant on our team, you will review documentation for accuracy, progress, and adherence to the design concept and system standards.

[Location masked] Citizenship
Experience formulating and defining system scope and objectives based on user/business needs
Ability to analyze business and user needs, document requirements, and translate both into proper system requirement specifications

Experience liaising across business and technical teams to communicate requirements to different stakeholders
Experience developing and tracking requirements through a Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) and working with testing specialists to develop use cases to test against the requirements
Proven experience effectively prioritizing workload to meet deadlines and work objectives

Demonstrated ability to write clearly, succinctly, and in a manner that appeals to a wide audience

cond_0100.responsibilities: The Requirements Analyst will work with product owners and our customers to identify and interpret software requirements and design specifications. You will also review client policies and processes to extract requirements for solution design. You will be expected to translate technical information into clear, readable documents to be used by technical and non-technical personnel. You will work across business and technical teams to help identify, track, and manage business, functional, and technical requirements throughout the full lifecycle of the solution, including creating and maintaining a Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) and providing support for testing against the requirements. As a senior consultant on our team, you will review documentation for accuracy, progress, and adherence to the design concept and system standards.

[Location masked] Citizenship required

cond_0114.intro:
We are looking for a Requirements Analyst to join our team.
Job Family: Cyber Consulting
Clearance Required: Ability to Obtain Public Trust
cond_0114.responsibilities:
The Requirements Analyst will work closely and regularly with product owners and customers to identify and interpret software requirements and design specifications. You will review client policies and processes to extract requirements for solution design, and translate technical information into clear, readable documents for both technical and non-technical personnel.
A large part of the role is staying in contact with business and technical teams to help identify, track, and manage business, functional, and technical requirements throughout the full lifecycle of the solution. This includes creating and maintaining a Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) and communicating with testing specialists to support testing against the requirements. As a senior consultant on our team, you will review documentation for accuracy, progress, and adherence to the design concept and system standards.

You will regularly review client policies and processes to extract requirements for solution design, and translate technical information into clear, readable documents for both technical and non-technical audiences. A large part of the role is staying in contact with business and technical teams to help identify, track, and manage business, functional, and technical requirements throughout the full lifecycle of the solution — including creating and maintaining a Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) and supporting testing against the requirements. As a senior consultant, you will review documentation for accuracy, progress, and adherence to design concepts and system standards.

The analyst will help identify, track, and manage business, functional, and technical requirements throughout the full lifecycle of the solution, including creating and maintaining a Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) and supporting testing against the requirements. As a senior consultant, the analyst will review documentation for accuracy, progress, and adherence to the design concept and system standards.

[Location masked] Citizenship required

Experience developing and tracking requirements through a Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) and working with testing specialists to develop use cases to test against the requirements
Proven experience effectively prioritizing workload to meet deadlines and work objectives
